title: Senior Software Development Engineer in Test
description:
**Job Overview**

We are looking for a **Senior** **SDET** to test the resilience and correctness of distributed backend systems supporting a high\-stakes account provisioning and onboarding workflow. This role is focused on the execution of pre\-approved, benign tracer/replay scenarios against staging endpoints, analysis of request/response behaviour, and documentation of observable account/CID lifecycle and downstream state behaviour.


The ideal candidate has strong distributed\-systems and API\-testing experience and maintains disciplined technical evidence capture and traceability.


This role is not intended to perform unrestricted adversarial testing. Testing activities will be limited to approved staging environments and pre\-approved benign scenarios.  



  

**Project Details**  

  

**Title:** Senior SDET  

**Rate:** $13\.5/hr
  

**Start Date:** 19th October  

**Duration:** 5 Weeks  

**Commitment**: 33 Hours per Week  

**Location:** India (Remote)  

**Job Type:** Freelance

### **Responsibilities**

* Analyze distributed system APIs to validate correctness, consistency, and failure handling across services involved in account creation, data persistence, and related record\-linking
* Execute pre\-approved request variations and boundary\-validation scenarios using sanitized tracer payloads against designated staging endpoints.
* Investigate system behavior under malformed, malicious, or unexpected inputs and document findings clearly
* Capture complete request/response evidence, including HTTP status codes, latency, headers, and payload bodies, subject to approved data\-handling requirements.
* Validate behavior of near\-real\-time inline checks (evaluated within milliseconds at the gateway) as distinct from longer\-running background verification/risk pipelines (evaluated over minutes to hours), confirming each layer of defense behaves as expected
* Verify data persistence, referential integrity, and correct linkage of related records/relationships written by backend services during processing
* Execute controlled replay suites and compare expected versus observed API behavior.
* Correlate replay results with the API schemas and network evidence produced by the Middleware SDET.
* Document observable account/CID lifecycle behavior and downstream state changes for handoff
* Capture and archive test logs and evidence in a structured, retrievable format to support audits and post\-incident reviews
* Collaborate with backend engineering teams to reproduce, isolate, and validate fixes for distributed\-system defects
* Contribute to test strategy for backend/middleware reliability, including failure\-mode and chaos\-style testing
* Maintain traceability between test evidence, defects, and system requirements
* Reconcile backend observations with the frontend FSM and middleware/API evidence produced by earlier workstreams.

### **Required Qualifications**

* Strong experience of **5\-8\+ years** in testing distributed systems and analyzing inter\-service API behavior
* Hands\-on experience with request payload tampering, fuzzing, or adversarial API testing techniques
* Understanding of layered defense architectures, including the distinction between synchronous/inline validation and asynchronous/background verification processes
* Familiarity with testing data persistence and relational/hierarchical integrity in backend data stores
* Demonstrated discipline in test log archival, evidence capture, and structured documentation practices
* Solid understanding of backend/middleware architecture, failure modes, and system boundaries
* Familiarity with API testing tools and scripting for building custom fuzzing/tampering test cases
* Strong analytical and investigative skills for root\-causing complex, systemic defects
* Experience executing controlled API replay or staging validation is strongly preferred.
* Experience correlating API responses with observable application/account lifecycle states is preferred.
* Experience supporting audit, compliance, or evidence\-based reporting requirements is a plus

title: Lead Software Development Engineer in Test
description:
**Overview**


We are seeking a Lead SDET (Software Development Engineer in Test ) to provide end\-to\-end technical governance across all QA layers — frontend, middleware, and backend — for a complex, multi\-layered onboarding platform. This role owns the architecture of API contract testing and the data modeling of complex entity relationships (e.g., hierarchical/parent\-child style structures), while ensuring that quality assumptions made at one layer (such as client\-side validation) are independently verified at every downstream layer rather than trusted at face value. The ideal candidate combines strong technical leadership with the ability to set and enforce delivery governance across cross\-functional teams.


**MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Provide technical governance across frontend, middleware, and backend testing layers.
* Establish and enforce QA delivery standards, evidence requirements, review processes, and quality gates.
* Review frontend constraint dictionaries and FSM/state\-model outputs for completeness and consistency.
* Review API schema reconstructions, network evidence, and tracer replay outputs for technical quality and traceability.
* Coordinate with QA Analysts, SDETs, and Test Operations Associates to align technical execution with delivery timelines.
* Review test architecture decisions, validation approaches, and coverage strategies.
* Coordinate dependency resolution, evidence rework, and cross\-layer reconciliation throughout the engagement.
* Act as the escalation point for cross\-layer technical discrepancies and evidence\-quality issues.
* Compile and quality\-check the raw technical evidence dossiers produced by the workstreams.
* Identify evidence gaps, inconsistencies, or areas requiring rework before handoff to client stakeholders.
* Report on delivery health, technical risks, evidence quality, dependencies, and unresolved gaps.
* Prepare the technical evidence package for handoff to the client team responsible for final modelling and logic\-gap assessment.
* Support technical readout preparation by ensuring that findings are traceable to empirical evidence.

**Project Details**

**Title**: Lead SDET **Rate:** $17/hr  

**Start Date:** 19th October  

**Duration:** 4 Months  

**Commitment:** 22 Hours per Week  

**Location:** India (Remote)  

**Job Type:** Contractual (with the possibility of a Full\-time employment extension based on performance and project needs)

**QUALIFICATIONS:**


* Proven experience of 8\+ years in a QA leadership role spanning multiple testing layers (frontend, middleware, backend)
* Demonstrated expertise in API contract testing architecture and governance
* Practical experience with knowledge graph or entity\-relationship data modeling and its application to test/data traceability
* Strong understanding of layered system architectures and the importance of independently verifying quality at each layer rather than relying on upstream assumptions
* Strong track record of technical delivery governance, including setting standards and quality gates
* Excellent cross\-functional leadership and stakeholder communication skills
* Deep technical grounding across QA disciplines (manual, automation, systems\-level testing) to credibly guide teams at every layer
* Experience mentoring or managing SDETs and QA Analysts
* Experience leading complex multi\-week technical QA, API validation, or security\-assessment engagements is strongly preferred.
* Experience establishing evidence/traceability models across complex technical workflows is preferred.
* Familiarity with knowledge graphs, entity\-relationship models, or structured technical dependency/evidence modeling is preferred; deep knowledge\-graph engineering expertise is not required.
* Ability to synthesize technical evidence into concise stakeholder\-ready findings and handoff materials.

title: SDET- API/Middleware
description:
**Job Overview**


Welo Global is hiring an **SDET** (Software Development Engineer in Test) to bring deep technical rigor to middleware\-layer testing. This role requires strong technical expertise across gRPC\-Web, Proto3, HTTP/2, JSON\-RPC/REST, proxy\-based traffic inspection, and API scripting. The primary responsibility is to observe and reconstruct the network interactions generated by the onboarding UI, including request/response structures, schemas, headers, identifiers, Enums, and client\-injected parameters. This is primarily an API/network analysis and evidence\-generation role rather than a conventional UI automation or regression\-testing role. The resource will produce sanitized network evidence and controlled, benign tracer replay scripts for downstream backend validation.  

  

**Project Details**  

  

**Title:** SDET \- API/Middleware  

**Rate:** $9\.50/hr  

**Start Date:** 19th October  

**Duration:** 5 Weeks  

**Commitment**: 35 Hours per Week  

**Location:** India (Remote)  

**Job Type:** Freelance

**Responsibilities**

* Design, build, and maintain automated API test suites covering gRPC\-Web, Proto3, HTTP/2, and JSON\-RPC/REST based services
* Export clean, sanitized HAR/network evidence while maintaining traceability between UI actions and corresponding network requests.
* Map relevant schemas, headers, identifiers, routing information, and client\-injected parameters.
* Use proxy tools such as Mitmproxy, Charles Proxy, and browser DevTools to inspect, intercept, and validate network traffic between client and server
* Develop and maintain API automation scripts using Python, Postman, and cURL for functional and regression testing
* Analyze protocol\-level request/response behavior to identify defects related to serialization, encoding, and transport
* Inspect and validate request payload structure, including system\-level headers (e.g., auth tokens, routing identifiers) and internal/hidden parameters, ensuring correct handling under both valid and malformed conditions
* Collaborate with backend and middleware engineers to define testable contracts and edge\-case scenarios
* Continuously improve test automation frameworks for reliability, speed, and maintainability
* Document technical findings, automation coverage, and known protocol\-level limitations

**Required Qualifications**

* Strong hands\-on expertise of **3\-5\+ years** with gRPC\-Web, Proto3, HTTP/2, and JSON\-RPC/REST protocols
* Proficiency with proxy/traffic inspection tools including Mitmproxy, Charles Proxy, and browser DevTools
* Solid scripting/programming skills in Python, with practical use of Postman and cURL for API automation
* Experience designing and maintaining automated test suites for middleware or API\-layer services
* Working understanding of API request structure, including headers, auth tokens, and internal/system parameters, and how to test for their correct handling
* Understanding of software engineering practices as applied to test automation (version control, CI integration, code review)
* Strong debugging skills at the network/protocol level
* Experience analysing browser\-generated network traffic and reconstructing API behaviour is strongly preferred.
* Experience with HAR analysis, API schema reconstruction, or controlled API replay is strongly preferred.
* Ability to work within approved staging/test environments and follow defined data\-handling and test\-authorization requirements is required.

title: Engineer - SDET ( Regression Testing)
description:
Bitwarden is looking for a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) to help the team grow confidently by building a suite of automated regression tests and driving a total\-quality approach to software development and delivery. You will contribute directly to the future of the Bitwarden product across web, browser extension, mobile, desktop, CLI, and server components, while working with a great team and an amazing open\-source community. This role is primarily for someone strong in C\#, test automation framework design, CI/CD integration, and engineering\-quality test code.


### **What You Will Do**


* Develop and maintain automated test scripts for web, browser extension, mobile, desktop, and CLI applications using C\# with Selenium/Appium.
* Design and implement robust, scalable, reusable, and maintainable test automation frameworks across multiple application types.
* Integrate automated tests into the CI/CD pipeline and ensure their reliable execution in build and delivery workflows.
* Collaborate with development and QA teams to understand requirements, identify test scenarios, and automate for comprehensive coverage.
* Execute automated tests, analyze results, and surface defects, performance issues, and areas for improvement.
* Review test automation code to uphold coding standards, best practices, and maintainability.
* Establish guidelines and processes for testing community and internal product contributions.
* Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, reporting automation progress, blockers, and upcoming sprint plans.
* Provide mentorship and guidance to junior team members on automation best practices and frameworks.
* Document frameworks and processes to support knowledge sharing and long\-term maintainability.

### **What you Bring**


* Strong C\# proficiency with substantial production test\-automation experience (3–5 years).
* Senior automation architecture capability: scalable, reusable, maintainable frameworks; readable/testable code; debugging and edge\-case handling across multiple application types.
* CI/CD integration ownership: embedding automated tests into build/delivery pipelines and keeping them stable and trustworthy.
* Solid command of software testing principles and methodologies, with clear collaboration in a distributed, cross\-functional team.
* Mobile test automation with Appium.
* Remote/cloud device and browser testing (Sauce Labs, BrowserStack, or similar).
* SaaS, security, identity, privacy, or developer\-facing product experience.
* Experience testing alongside and integrating with backend/API services.
* Mentoring junior automation engineers and reviewing test code.
* Experience working in global, distributed technical teams.
* Hands\-on AI/ML experience beyond tooling (evaluating or applying AI\-generated tests).

**Why Join Us**
---------------



This is an opportunity to play a foundational role in shaping our India Engineering COE from the ground up. Our user community loves us and we love them. Come to work each day with a sense of purpose as we bring a more secure internet experience to everyone from our friends and family to the world's largest organizations.



Become an expert. You'll get immersed in the prominent technology markets of security and open source software. You'll work alongside talented global teams, solve meaningful engineering challenges, influence how we scale our engineering organization \& contribute to products used by customers around the world.



If you're passionate about building exceptional teams, enabling engineering excellence, and making a lasting impact within a fast\-growing engineering company, we'd love to hear from you.


**Equal Opportunity Employer**
------------------------------



We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone can do their best work. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and make employment decisions based on skills, experience, qualifications, and business needs.

title: Automation Engineer
description:
Automation \& Agentic AI Engineer

**Location:** Delhi / Remote  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time  
**Experience:** 1–3 years

About the Role

We’re looking for an **Automation \& Agentic AI Engineer** who can turn repetitive business processes into intelligent, automated workflows.

You’ll work with **n8n, APIs, AI/LLMs, databases, CRMs, and business tools** to build systems that reduce manual work and improve business efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

* Build and maintain complex **n8n automation workflows**
* Identify and automate repetitive business processes
* Build **AI agents and agentic workflows** using LLMs
* Integrate APIs, CRMs, databases, SaaS tools, webhooks, WhatsApp, email, Google Workspace and other platforms
* Build automation for **sales, marketing, lead management, customer support, reporting and operations**
* Implement AI for classification, extraction, summarization, analysis and decision\-making
* Build automated lead qualification, routing, follow\-ups, notifications and reporting
* Create workflows with **human approval and escalation** where required
* Debug workflows, improve reliability and document automation systems
* Research and experiment with new AI and automation tools

AI / Agentic AI

Experience or interest in building:

* AI\-powered lead qualification and routing
* AI agents that interact with APIs and business tools
* Automated research and data collection
* AI\-generated reports and summaries
* LLM\-powered data extraction and classification
* RAG / knowledge\-base workflows
* Multi\-step agentic workflows with human\-in\-the\-loop approval

Required Skills

**Automation**

* Strong hands\-on experience with **n8n**
* REST APIs, webhooks and JSON
* OAuth / API authentication
* Workflow debugging and error handling

**AI**

* OpenAI, Gemini, Claude or similar LLM APIs
* Prompt engineering and structured outputs
* Function/tool calling
* AI agents / agentic workflows
* Basic understanding of RAG and embeddings

**Technical**

* JavaScript / TypeScript or Python
* SQL / databases
* Git / GitHub
* Basic cloud/server concepts
* Understanding of authentication and asynchronous workflows

Good to Have

* Supabase / PostgreSQL / Redis
* CRM and WhatsApp / Meta API integrations
* Google Workspace APIs
* Docker and n8n deployment
* LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI or similar frameworks
* Experience building AI\-powered internal tools
* SaaS automation or startup experience

What We’re Looking For

We value **problem\-solving ability and practical experience over certificates**.

You should be someone who:

* Naturally asks, **“Can this be automated?”**
* Can turn an unclear business problem into a technical solution
* Learns new APIs and tools independently
* Can work with minimal supervision
* Enjoys experimenting with new AI technologies
* Understands that automation is about **business outcomes, not just connecting nodes**
* Can build quickly while considering reliability and scalability

Example Projects

* Build an AI system that captures, qualifies and routes leads, updates the CRM and triggers automated follow\-ups.
* Automate weekly management reports by collecting data from multiple systems and generating an AI\-powered summary.
* Build a workflow that reads customer emails, extracts requirements, updates the database and triggers the next action.

Why Join Us?

Work on **real\-world AI and automation systems** that solve meaningful business problems—not just repetitive maintenance tasks.

If you see a repetitive process and immediately think **“We should automate this,”** you’ll probably fit right in.

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹35,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Internet reimbursement
* Leave encashment
* Paid sick time

Work Location: In person
